en: New topic (press 0 on the home screen): the angle between two vectors, or angle ABC from three points. Choose the angle between vectors (0 to 180°) or the acute angle between lines, in degrees or radians. With a letter such as m in a vector, type the angle to find m.
Kinematics: Find can be one function, such as v(x), t(x) or x(v). It is worked out from the others, with the working.
zh: 新题型（首页按 0）：两个向量的夹角，或由三个点求 ∠ABC。可选向量夹角（0 到 180°）或直线夹角（锐角），角度或弧度都行。向量里有字母（如 m）时，填入夹角就能求出 m。
运动学：“求”可以选一个函数，比如 v(x)、t(x) 或 x(v)，由其他关系推出来并写出步骤。

en: Two editions: vce.tns is English only, vce_zh.tns shows Chinese and English (and can switch to English).
The version is shown in the Help title bar (menu › Help), so you can compare it with this site.
zh: 分成两个版本：vce.tns 纯英文，vce_zh.tns 中英双语（也可以切换成纯英文）。
帮助页（menu › Help）的标题栏显示版本号，方便和网站上的最新版对比。

en: New topics: find unknown constants, transformations of graphs, simultaneous equations with a parameter, sample proportion.
Simpler home screen: one Probability entry, MM / SM badges, larger text and calmer colours.
Kinematics: choose what to find (x, v, a or t); a note says which condition is missing.
Volumes of revolution with limits in y (y = 1 to y = 4) and letters such as a in the limits.
Asymptotes stay visible when they lie on an axis.
zh: 新增题型：求未知常数、函数图像变换、含参数的方程组、样本比例 p̂。
首页更简单：概率统计合成一个入口，标出 MM / SM，字更大、颜色更柔和。
运动学：可以直接选要求 x、v、a 还是 t；条件不够时会提示缺哪个条件。
旋转体体积支持 y 的范围（从 y=1 到 y=4），范围里可以有字母常数，比如 a。
渐近线和坐标轴重合时也能看见。

en: First release: probability (normal, binomial, discrete, PDF, confidence intervals, hypothesis tests), SUVAT, kinematics, function graphs, areas and volumes, DE models.
Every answer comes with VCE-style working; switch any answer between exact and decimal.
zh: 第一个版本：概率统计（正态、二项、离散、概率密度、置信区间、假设检验）、匀加速 SUVAT、运动学、函数图像、面积与体积、微分方程模型。
每个答案都带 VCE 评分习惯的步骤；精确值和小数可以随时切换。
